{"reason":"Add a high-confidence gate to the existing magnitude, exposure, and non-frozen checks. V1's recall is 1.0, but its false-arbitration rate is 0.714 (20 of 28), and six of the eight displayed false positives have confidence below 0.7. Filtering those rows should reduce false arbitration while retaining high-confidence positives and meeting the 0.8 recall gate.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
